_note: P0-2 engine-dehardcode: module-level engine config for the Cyberpunk RED Homecoming one-shot. Migrates trpg-combat's hardcoded npc.scav_boss / npc.athena_drone literals (target_actor_for_combat_input) and the inferred_homecoming_tech_dv 14/12 table into data. trpg-db load_module_config reads this by module_id. matcher entries are case-insensitive substrings; the first binding/row that hits wins (same order as the legacy if/else-if chain). The legacy scav_boss compound condition (scav AND (老大|leader)) is approximated as the integral matchers 'scav 老大' / 'scav leader' (single-keyword table cannot express AND); the four independent scav_boss keywords are exact. The 'director' block (P0-2 T4) migrates trpg-director's deleted is_homecoming() hardcode (scene facts / pressure / affordances / risk / biased NPC advice / open question / no-location place summary), copied verbatim from the original Rust so the Homecoming run is byte-equivalent. module_search_profile (P0-2 T5) migrates module_preferences_for contains('homecoming') logic. DONE_WITH_CONCERNS: a future module-reader pass should auto-extract these from parsed scene ScenarioNode data and retire this override block. Pure data, no per-ruleset/module Rust.

scene_facts.text: 无人机、警察、仓库入口、外露电缆和内部服务器噪音形成同一个局势面：威胁、救援、技术源头和情报价值同时存在。

pressure_items.text: 如果继续拖延，现场伤员、外部势力和设备过载都会推进局势。
pressure_items.consequence_hint: 警察伤势恶化、敌对势力抵达、仓库内源头转移或过载

affordance_items.description: 外露电缆是可观察的交互抓手；它暗示供能、数据或控制关系。
受困警察和封锁街口是救援、社交和现场资源的抓手。
仓库内部的噪音与外部威胁同步，说明源头可能不在无人机本体。

risk_items.text: 直接摧毁威胁最简单，但可能损失情报、报酬或后续线索。

npc_advice.bias_or_goal: 想活下来，优先压制威胁，不关心情报价值。

npc_advice.advice_text: 别把值钱的情报打烂，查清它从哪来的。
npc_advice.bias_or_goal: 想要可出售的信息或技术，低估现场救援压力。

known_facts: 现场至少不是单一战斗问题：它同时是救援、威胁控制、源头调查和资源取舍。
director.open_question: 你们优先救人、控制威胁、追查源头、获取资源，还是撤离保命？
director.place_summary_fallback: 当前地点：Cyberpunk RED Homecoming 开场附近；一个高压现场正在等待玩家选择目标。
